hud.title: UI HUD
hud.description: A handy game bottom bar replacing the default hotbar.
hud.details:
Portrait, HP and AC
Skill bar with tabs and a custom macro bar
Action / bonus / reaction pips and movement with Dash
Spell slots and class resources
End turn, short and long rest
WoW-style micro menu instead of sidebar tabs
Each player can hide it (Shift+H)
4 tabs for everyone: Favorites, Attack, Spells, Reactions — drag freely, right-click menu, lock

portraits.title: Voice portraits
portraits.description: Player and GM portraits that animate when the person talks.
portraits.details:
Voice from a Discord bot, Yandex Telemost or Foundry A/V
Emotions and chat bubbles
With the UI HUD: your portrait in the circle, others in a column on the left

combat.title: Auto combat: damage and saves
combat.description: Checks hits against AC and applies damage; collects saving throws for cones and AoE.
combat.details:
Attack vs target AC (nat 20 always hits, nat 1 always misses)
Damage auto-rolls and applies only to targets that were hit
AoE: everyone in the template gets a save card, monsters roll automatically
Fail — full damage, success — half or none
Summary in chat with an Undo button for the GM
Requires an active GM; don't use together with Midi-QOL

rolls.title: Epic roll requests
rolls.description: The GM asks players for a roll — the screen dims and an epic roll card appears.
rolls.details:
d20 button on the left toolbar (GM)
Targets are character tokens on the scene
Ability check, save, skill or custom formula; DC, advantage/disadvantage
Player clicks Roll; the GM can roll for an absent player
Everyone sees the result and success/failure with a sound
Works with 3D dice
Macro: game.rpgSuite.api.rolls.request({...})

loot.title: Party loot
loot.description: After combat the GM splits gold evenly; players roll Need / Greed / Pass for items like in WoW.
loot.details:
Reward card after combat ends
💰 button on the left toolbar and in the combat tracker
Drag items, enter gold
Gold is split and added immediately
Timed Need / Greed / Pass window per item; ties are broken with d100
The item goes straight to the winner

reactions.title: Reactions
reactions.description: Offers a reaction at the right moment: Shield, Counterspell, Deflect Missiles, Uncanny Dodge…
reactions.details:
A hit triggers a 'Use reaction?' prompt
Shield: +5 AC until your turn
Counterspell: interrupt an enemy spell within 60 ft
Deflect Missiles and Uncanny Dodge reduce the next damage
⚡ button on item sheets to configure custom reactions
With Auto combat: damage waits for the reaction answer
With the UI HUD: the reaction pip is marked automatically

dice.title: 3D dice
dice.description: Lightweight 3D dice roll across the table on every roll.
dice.details:
d2–d100 plus d3, d5, d30, Fate dice
The top face always matches the chat result
Everyone sees the roller's colour; hidden rolls stay hidden
Each player picks a colour
The GM sets size and time on table
Don't use together with Dice So Nice

gmbar.title: GM bar
gmbar.description: A free-floating slot bar for the GM only: macros, monster abilities, tables and music at hand, independent of the selected token.
gmbar.details:
Separate window: drag by the header, collapse, lock
Configurable grid: rows × slots per row (2 × 6 = 12 by default) and pages
Flip pages with the header arrows or the mouse wheel
Drop macros, items or abilities from monster sheets, activities, tables, journals, actors, scenes, playlists or sounds
Click — use (a monster ability is used by that monster regardless of the selected token), Shift+click — open, right-click — menu
Rearrange slots by dragging, even across pages
Toolbox button on the left toolbar or Shift+G — show / hide
Stored on the GM user, same in every browser; players never see it

initiative.title: Initiative bar
initiative.description: Combatant portraits in initiative order along the top of the screen.
initiative.details:
Turn order portraits at the top during combat, current one highlighted
Optional HP bars
Token or actor portraits
Top offset, size and player visibility
“Gather combat”: GM window with all scene tokens and checkboxes → “Fight”

calendar.title: Calendar & weather
calendar.description: In-game date and time of day, animated weather, temperature and party location.
calendar.details:
Widget: time, part of day, date, weekday, season, moon phase
Animated weather and daily temperature curve
GM controls: ±1 h, ±10 min, start/stop, long rest, +1 day
Real-time clock with auto-pause
Gregorian (default), Harptos or custom calendars with a month editor
Party location, auto weather, chat announcements

light.title: Light & torches
light.description: Torches, candles, lamps and lanterns by D&D rules: token HUD button, item use, burn time.
light.details:
Flame button in the token HUD or Shift+L
Torch, candle, lamp, hooded and bullseye lantern
Consumes torches, candles or oil; remaining time is kept
Burnt-out lights go out by themselves
Animated flame badge
Best with the Vision 5e module

lockpick.title: Lockpicking
lockpick.description: Locked doors and chests: pick with thieves' tools or a lockpick, or break them by force.
lockpick.details:
Right-click a locked door's lock icon
Thieves' tools, lockpick, break (STR or Athletics)
Per-door DCs; Shift+right-click to test as GM
Locked chests of «Chests, merchants & trade» too
Lockpicks may break; DC hidden from players

piles.title: Chests, merchants & trade
piles.description: Chests and loot piles on the map, merchant shops, WoW-style trading, custom currency.
piles.details:
Tile chests: locked / closed / open, images, sounds, contents
Loot piles: drop items on the map, token → pile
Merchants with markup, buyback, infinite stock
Player-to-player trade
Standard, gold-only or custom currency
Requires the GM online
Chests and bags can be locked; open with tools, picks or brute force

mannequin.title: Equipment mannequin
mannequin.description: MMORPG-style paper doll next to the character sheet.
mannequin.details:
Paper doll with slots next to the sheet
Equipping puts the item into its slot
Left-click opens, right-click unequips
Drag & drop between slots
Rarity frames, attunement mark

whisper.title: GM whisper
whisper.description: Secret messages from the GM to chosen players with sound and a glowing icon.
whisper.details:
Lips button on the left toolbar or Alt+W
Pick players, write, send
Soft chime and glowing icon for the player
Persistent threads, replies
Unread markers

notebook.title: Sketch notebook
notebook.description: A personal notebook for everyone and a sketch canvas for the GM.
notebook.details:
Floating book button, toolbar button or Shift+B
Private notes with autosave and search
Canvas: brushes, colours, size, background, undo
Save to notebook and/or post to chat
Anyone can save a sketch from chat
